note: One entry per count this gate governs. An entry names the file and the line the count is written on, a pattern that reads it out of that line, the command that re-derives it from the tree, and a pattern that reads the derived number out of that command's output. The registry stores no number: the document holds the only copy, so an entry cannot pass by agreeing with a copy of itself. A count no command re-derives does not belong here - an entry that holds an expected value and runs nothing is the same drift with a gate painted on it. `node scripts/check-source-claims.mjs` re-runs every command and fails on a disagreement, on a command that cannot run, and on a command whose output carries no number.

claims.claim: how many fixtures the core runner counts
how many of the counted fixtures import node:test

derived.cmd: node scripts/run-tests.mjs --list | awk '$1=="counted"{print "test/runtime/"$2}' | xargs grep -lE 'from +.{0,2}node:test' | wc -l

claims.claim: the loader fixture's child drivers, as its runner allowance reason states them
how many of those drivers run at a time, as the same reason states it
how many skills the package ships
how many extensions the manifest registers
